verdicts: Registers are most of a run's power. With none, the sensible player wins 1% on today's quotas (median shift-8 total €80, against €274 today).
Option A (no guarantee) needs quotas cut about in half from shift 3 on (120 → 63). Then any run with 3 registers wins 80–96%, and the total barely grows over a run, which works against #77's goal.
Option B (STAMP DAY floor), recommended, keeps today's quotas. Never choosing REGISTER wins 32% (rerun 30%), or 35% ± 10 taking UPGRADES blind; the 40% row* saw the drops first (today: 61%).
Watch: GOLDEN Milk, 1.0–1.5 copies per run. 'One fits your cart' inside the tier did not help (24% ± 8): the drop from 61% is the tiers. Breakfast special narrowly fails the #42 check under B.
